desc:
Shopify bundles and upsell setup lets customers buy more in one order through product bundles, volume discounts and cart offers. Ecom Swift LLC installs and configures Sleek Bundles on your store, styles the offers to match your theme and tests the full checkout.

## What are Shopify bundles and upsells?

Shopify bundles are offers that group products, or quantities of one product, at a combined or discounted price. Upsells and cross-sells are suggestions shown on product pages, in the cart or after checkout that encourage shoppers to add something more. Together they raise the value of each order without needing more traffic.

A bundle can be a fixed set, such as a starter kit, or a volume offer such as buy two, get a lower price on the third. Mix and match and build-your-own bundles let shoppers choose items from a collection. Each type solves a different buying situation.

## Why order value is worth working on

Getting a visitor to your store costs money, whether it is ad spend, content or time. Once they are there, a small nudge toward a complementary product costs almost nothing. Stores that only sell single items one at a time leave this opportunity untouched.

Bundles also help shoppers. Someone buying a camera strap may not know the matching case exists. A clear offer saves them searching and gives them a reason to commit to a larger purchase now.

## How bundles affect revenue and margin

The mechanism is simple: more items per order spreads the cost of shipping, payment fees and customer acquisition across a larger sale. Volume discounts also encourage shoppers to stock up on products they already like, which can move slow-selling stock.

Margin matters as much as revenue. A discount that is too deep can make a larger order less profitable than a smaller one. That is why we check the maths on each offer before it goes live. Results depend on your catalog, your traffic and your prices, so we build the offers and make them easy to adjust rather than promising a number.

## What good bundle and upsell setup includes

- Offers built from products that make sense together, not random pairings.
- Clear discount rules: fixed price, percentage, free item or tiered quantity.
- An offer widget on the product page that is easy to read on a phone.
- Styling that matches your theme fonts, colors and button shapes.
- A cart or mini-cart upsell block with relevant suggestions.
- Mix and match or build-your-own bundles for stores with many variants.
- Discounts that apply correctly at checkout alongside shipping and tax.
- Inventory behavior that makes sense when a bundled product runs out.
- Offer tracking in your analytics, so you can see which offers get used.
- A short guide or video so your team can add new bundles later.

## How we set it up

We begin with your catalog and sales data. We look for products that are bought together, items with healthy margin and slow sellers that could join a bundle. Then we agree the offers with you.

Next we install Sleek Bundles, the app we build and support ourselves, and connect it to your store. We create each offer, choose the product pages where it appears, and style it to match your theme. We check the layout on real phones and tablets, then place test orders to confirm the discount, the cart total and the checkout all behave correctly. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in how many offers we create and how much of the cart, tracking and pricing work is included.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Bundle products that a shopper would genuinely use together.
- Work out your margin on every offer before it goes live.
- Keep the offer message short and easy to understand at a glance.
- Place the strongest offer on your best-selling product pages first.
- Test a bundle by buying it yourself on your phone.

**Avoid:**
- Stacking several discounts that conflict with each other.
- Showing so many offers that shoppers feel pressured or confused.
- Bundling items with very different shipping needs without checking rates.
- Hiding the real total until the last step of checkout.
- Leaving old offers running after the stock or season has changed.

## Who this is for

This service suits stores with products that naturally pair, such as skincare, apparel, accessories and consumables. It also suits merchants with a high-volume product who want a quantity discount, and stores with strong traffic but small baskets. If you sell a single item with no related products, we will tell you honestly whether bundles would help.

## What we need from you

Tell us which products you want to promote and any pricing limits we must respect. Give us collaborator or staff access to your Shopify store so we can install the app and edit the relevant theme areas. We never need your password. If you also want analytics tracking, tell us which tool you use. After we finish, you receive the guide so your team can create new offers on their own.
